# EmergentSparsity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where frozen, randomly initialized CNN feature extractors naturally develop sparse activation patterns without any training or pruning. Suggests that random feature extractors can be used as low-cost, energy-efficient front-ends in TCC/iNEST systems, reducing the need for trained layers in resource-constrained network nodes.
